description: This file defines CMake functions and macros to facilitate the installation and configuration of header-only libraries and packages. It includes functions for generating configuration files and pkg-config files, managing dependencies, and setting installation paths tailored for header-only CMake projects.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a CMake configuration for a header-only library target, generating necessary version and target files, and handling dependencies.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Creates a pkg-config style file for a header-only package, including compile options, include directories, and linked libraries.
